info.description: API Documentation for WasteNot Android Backend (Waste Logging, Gamification, Guides & AI Scan)
info.title: WasteNot API

get.description: Check if the API process is alive
Check if PostgreSQL database and core schema migrations are ready
Retrieve achievement definitions and derived unlock/progress state for the authenticated user

post.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG image (max 5MB) to detect waste object candidates

delete.description: Soft-delete an AI detection operation and its snapshot

get.description: Retrieve the catalog of waste objects detectable by the AI vision service

post.description: Request an AI disposal recommendation from a detection candidate or manual object selection
Exchange a verified Google ID token and single-use nonce for a WasteNot session. Linking an existing password account also requires its current password.

parameters.description: Google ID token, time zone, and optional WasteNot linking proof
parameters.name: req

post.description: Return a five-minute single-use nonce. Pass it to Google when requesting an ID token for sign-in or account deletion.
Authenticate with email and password to receive access and refresh tokens
Revoke the current authenticated session and refresh token chain
Accept a conditional recovery request. A code is emailed only for an existing account, never returned here.
Consume a single-use recovery code, replace the password and revoke every session atomically.
Rotate refresh token and issue a new access/refresh token pair
Register a new WasteNot user account and issue initial session tokens

get.description: Retrieve today's waste summary, recent logs, and gamification progress
Retrieve the authenticated user's profile and gamification progress

delete.description: Verify the current password or a fresh token from the linked Google account, cascade owned data and remove private photo files. Storage failures return 503 with durable cleanup pending, never a confirmed purge.

parameters.description: Exactly one current password or Google ID token
parameters.name: req

get.description: Retrieve supported waste categories, methods, validation limits, and feature capabilities

post.description: Upload a validated JPEG, PNG, or WebP image (max 5 MiB) for attaching to a waste log

get.description: Download an authenticated user's private photo attachment

delete.description: Delete a staged photo attachment owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Retrieve aggregated waste statistics, daily trends, and category breakdown for a date range

parameters.description: Start Date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to 6 days before 'to')
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: End Date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to user's today)
parameters.name: to

get.description: Search and filter waste disposal guides with cursor pagination

parameters.description: Waste Category (ORGANIC, PLASTIC, PAPER, GLASS, METAL, ELECTRONIC, OTHER)
parameters.name: category

get.description: Retrieve detailed instructions and tips for a specific waste guide entry
Retrieve cursor-paginated waste logs filtered by category, method, and date range

parameters.description: Waste Category (ORGANIC, PLASTIC, PAPER, GLASS, METAL, ELECTRONIC, OTHER)
parameters.name: category

post.description: Record a new waste management activity with idempotency support via client_request_id

get.description: Retrieve a specific waste log entry belonging to the authenticated user

delete.description: Soft-delete a waste log entry with If-Match version precondition

patch.description: Partially update an existing waste log using optimistic concurrency control (version)
